guitar.evidence: Carl Wilson played electric guitar (Fender models) in the Beach Boys, but the band's sound is vocal/production-driven, not guitar-iconic.

tone.target: bright clean pop with vibey studio textures
tone.profile: bright clean pop with vibey studio textures
tone.summary: A bright, airy signal chain utilizing a clean Fender-style amp (US Deluxe) combined with Chorus, Wah, and Tape delay to capture the psychedelic, layered sound of 'Good Vibrations'.
